Scale Weights Using Method D2

Source: R/validation.R
scale_weights_d2.Rd

Internal function to scale survey weights using the D2 method (Pfeffermann et al., 1998).

Usage

scale_weights_d2(weight, state_id, domain_summary)

Arguments

weight

Original survey weights.

state_id

State/domain IDs.

domain_summary

Domain summary from compute_domain_summary().

Value

Scaled weights.
